correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs \(\lambda_2=2\operatorname{Cov}(Q(U),U)\), conditions on the atom index, applies Cauchy--Schwarz, and computes \(\operatorname{Var}(\mathbb E[U\mid J])=(1-\sum_i p_i^3)/12\) exactly from total variance. Equality conditions are necessary and sufficient, and the atom-count corollary follows from strict convexity of \(t^3\). Random numerical checks were used only as stress tests.
